note: No queryable zoning district service found for Ransom County (FIPS 38073). The county homepage links no zoning map or GIS service; the county's 1999 zoning ordinance is cited by the ND AG but its map is not published. Lisbon's zoning map is 'on file in the Office of the Code Administrator' (Lisbon ordinance s.15.42.1), not online. Fort Ransom zoning appears only in a 2025 public notice. Enderlin has no zoning layer. ArcGIS searches for Ransom County zoning returned only roads, parcels, townships and other state layers; the NDGIS Hub has parcels but no zoning layer.
